paper_title: EGG: An Expert-Guided Agent Framework for Kernel Generation
target_claims: EGG decomposes kernel generation into algorithmic structure design and hardware-specific tuning with stage-aware multi-agent collaboration (Figure 1).
On KernelBench, EGG reports 100% success at Levels 1, 2, and 3 with speedups of 1.83x, 2.73x, and 1.52x over PyTorch Eager (Table 1).

The overall EGG system reports 87.6% Fast1 and 2.13x speedup, while ablations without multi-seed search, algorithmic refinement, hardware tuning, or multi-agent collaboration reduce speedup (Table 2).

verification_plan.execution_path: Implement deterministic synthetic benchmark tests and standalone PyTorch/CPU kernel generation evaluation pipelines for EGG multi-agent stage decomposition and KernelBench speedup metrics.
